clue.text: Vet show on television?

definitions.meaning: to vet is to check someone over before approving them

explanation.surface: A puzzled question about whether the vet has a TV programme.
explanation.definitionFit: Vetting candidates and broadcasting a film are both senses of the same verb.

clue.text: Solitary soldier without a grave

parts.note: solitary means sole, the only one

indicators.note: the soldier is left without the letter given by the following a

parts.note: a soldier is a man, one of the ranks

explanation.surface: A lone soldier lacking a burial place.
explanation.walkthrough: 'grave' looks like a burial noun next to 'soldier'; it is an adjective meaning serious.
explanation.definitionFit: Grave and serious in manner are synonyms when describing a mood or occasion.

clue.text: Scrutinise skirt getting forward?

parts.note: to read a document is to scrutinise it
a skirt is loosely a dress, a garment for the lower body

explanation.surface: Someone inspecting a skirt that is becoming rather forward.
explanation.definitionFit: To forward a letter is to send it on to a new address, putting a fresh destination on it.

clue.text: Sad English member upset CIA

parts.note: a leg is a limb, a member of the body

indicators.note: upset means knocked over and disordered, so the letters of CIA are jumbled

explanation.surface: An English politician is upset with the CIA.
explanation.definitionFit: Elegiac means mournful, in the manner of a lament for the dead.

clue.text: Street along with a road guide

parts.note: ST is the usual short form for street on maps and addresses
along with means and
RD is the usual short form for road on maps and addresses

explanation.surface: Directions to a street next to a road, like a guidebook.
explanation.definitionFit: A standard is a benchmark or model that serves as a guide for judgment.

clue.text: Tackling Romulan Empire Kirk starts journey

indicators.note: the starts of the four words Tackling, Romulan, Empire, Kirk are taken in turn

explanation.surface: Captain Kirk taking on the Romulan Empire, a Star Trek plot.
explanation.walkthrough: Romulans and Captain Kirk come from Star Trek, so the answer sits neatly in the scene.
explanation.definitionFit: A trek is a long, arduous journey, usually on foot.

clue.text: Tell made a bolt lifting speed

indicators.note: in a down clue lifting means raised up, so the letters are read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: to make a bolt for it is to run, so made a bolt means ran
rate means speed, as in a rate of knots

explanation.surface: Someone describes a bolt being fitted at speed.
explanation.definitionFit: To tell a story is to recount it, giving an account of events.

clue.text: Active US soldier with bitter exterior

indicators.note: the beer forms the outside, wrapped round the soldier

parts.note: bitter is a type of English beer, an ale
GI is the common term for an American soldier

explanation.surface: A lively American serviceman with a sour outer manner.
explanation.definitionFit: Agile means nimble and quick-moving, so physically active.

clue.text: Loathing endless calamity installing team's leader

indicators.note: the shortened calamity takes a letter inside it, putting it in place
the calamity word loses its final letter, so it has no end

parts.note: a calamity is a disaster

indicators.note: the leader of team's is its first letter

explanation.surface: Hatred caused by a never-ending catastrophe when a new captain arrives.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endless' trims DISASTER to DISASTE, and 'installing' puts T inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Distaste is strong dislike or aversion, close to loathing.

clue.text: Metal containing iron is green, perhaps

indicators.note: the metal holds the symbol inside it

parts.note: lead is a heavy metal
FE is the chemical symbol for iron

explanation.surface: A chemistry note: a metal alloyed with iron turns green.
explanation.walkthrough: 'green' suggests copper patina, but here it describes foliage.
explanation.definitionFit: A tree that has leafed is covered in foliage, so green is an example of how it looks.

clue.text: Runs into delays so gets off Eurostar?

indicators.note: the runs letter goes into the middle of the delays word

parts.note: to detain someone is to delay them
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

explanation.surface: A traveller hits delays and abandons the cross-Channel train.
explanation.walkthrough: Eurostar is the passenger train between London and Paris; the question mark marks it as one example of a train.
explanation.definitionFit: To detrain is to alight from a railway carriage, as passengers leaving a Eurostar do.

clue.text: Football team rose and improved field?

parts.note: Man U is the familiar short name of Manchester United football club
rose is a pinkish red, a shade of the colour

explanation.surface: A football team climbs the table and its pitch gets better.
explanation.walkthrough: Manchester United is a famous English football club. 'rose' looks like a verb; it is the colour.
explanation.definitionFit: A farmer spreads dung to fertilise a field, enriching the soil so it improves.

clue.text: Crazy outfit with nearly every single song

parts.note: crazy means mad
a rig or rig-out is an outfit of clothes

indicators.note: nearly drops the last letter of the word for every single

parts.note: every single one means all of them

explanation.surface: A wild costume worn for nearly every solo number.
explanation.walkthrough: 'nearly' cuts ALL to AL. 'single' looks like it belongs with 'song'; it belongs with 'every'.
explanation.definitionFit: A madrigal is a Renaissance part-song for several unaccompanied voices.

clue.text: One captures image originated by artist

parts.note: originated means came, as in came from somewhere
RA is a Royal Academician, a member of the Royal Academy of Arts

explanation.surface: Someone captures a picture first conceived by a painter.
explanation.definitionFit: A photographic device records pictures, capturing an image when the shutter opens.

clue.text: Detailed sign accepting of French accent

indicators.note: the shortened sign takes in the French word, accepting it inside
detailed here means de-tailed, the sign losing its tail letter

parts.note: Cancer is a sign of the zodiac
de is French for of

explanation.surface: A careful sign that takes on a French accent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Detailed' reads as 'thorough' but is a pun on de-tailed: the zodiac sign loses its tail letter before 'accepting' puts the French word inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Cadence is the rise and fall of the voice in speech, a lilt or intonation.

clue.text: Excitedly augment encore giving cheer

indicators.note: something done excitedly is done in agitation, so these letters are stirred into a new order

explanation.surface: An enthusiastic audience boosts their encore calls with cheering.
explanation.definitionFit: Cheer here is support and heartening, the urging on of someone to keep going.

clue.text: Finish university career keeping new resolution

parts.note: end means finish

indicators.note: the race word keeps a letter inside it

parts.note: to career is to rush along, to race

explanation.surface: Finishing university and launching a career with a fresh determination.
explanation.walkthrough: 'career' looks like a job; it is the verb meaning to race.
explanation.definitionFit: Resolution as staying power and determination matches the capacity to hold out under strain.

clue.text: Mao dirge changed Chinese character?

indicators.note: changed signals that these letters are altered into a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: A funeral song for Chairman Mao altered by a Chinese figure.
explanation.definitionFit: A Chinese written symbol stands for an idea rather than a sound, so it is one example of such a sign.

clue.text: Strangely, dessert in diet is neutral

indicators.note: strangely signals that the letters are put into an odd, unexpected order

explanation.surface: Oddly, a pudding included in a slimming plan has no effect either way.
explanation.definitionFit: Being impartial and unbiased, with no stake in the outcome, is neutral.

clue.text: Cancels practically recent openings

indicators.note: practically means almost, so the recent word loses its last letter

parts.note: recent means new
gates are openings in a fence or wall

explanation.surface: A notice cancelling nearly all the recently opened entrances.
explanation.definitionFit: To negate something is to nullify it, cancelling out its effect.

clue.text: Large number certain to see crop circle?

parts.note: a ton is a hundred, a large number in informal speech
certain means sure

explanation.surface: Plenty of people are sure to see a crop circle in a field.
explanation.walkthrough: 'crop circle' suggests flattened corn; here 'crop' is a haircut.
explanation.definitionFit: A monk's shaven crown leaves a ring of hair, so the haircut is a circle cropped on the head.

clue.text: Criminal cheat with never-ending bird

parts.note: a con is a convict, a criminal
to do someone is to cheat them

indicators.note: the ending of never is its final letter

explanation.surface: A crook swindling someone with an endless ruse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'never-ending' looks like 'endless'; it gives the end of 'never'.
explanation.definitionFit: A huge vulture of the Andes and California is a bird, the largest flying land bird.

clue.text: Shock dropping resistance for power cut

indicators.note: the shock word drops a letter, losing it

parts.note: outrage is shock and indignation
R is the symbol for electrical resistance

explanation.surface: An electrical shock blowing the resistance and cutting the power.
explanation.definitionFit: An outage is a period when the electricity supply fails, a blackout.

clue.text: God of sex raised cane

indicators.note: in a down clue raised means lifted up, so the letters are read backwards

parts.note: it is sex appeal or sex itself, as in having it
to tan someone is to beat them, to cane them

explanation.surface: A deity of lust lifting a stick.
explanation.definitionFit: The Titans were the elder deities of Greek myth, overthrown by Zeus.

clue.text: Plot in coarse ground

indicators.note: ground means milled or crushed, so the letters are broken up and rearranged

explanation.surface: A garden plot made of rough earth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Plot' and 'ground' both look like land; 'ground' is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A plot is a storyline, the outline of events in a film or play.

clue.text: Endured tedious person in pub?

definitions.meaning: endured means put up with or suffered
a dull talker who pins people down at the bar

explanation.surface: Someone put up with a tiresome drinker at the local.
explanation.definitionFit: The past tense of bear means suffered, and a dull person is the noun with the same spelling.

clue.text: Part includes old time turn

indicators.note: the part word includes the next letters within it

parts.note: a ration is a part or share

explanation.surface: An actor's role covers an old-fashioned spell on stage.
explanation.definitionFit: A rotation is a single revolution, one turn of a wheel.

clue.text: Regretted describing hip being damaged

indicators.note: describing is used in its sense of drawing round, so the regret word circles the next one

parts.note: rued means regretted
hip means fashionable, in

explanation.surface: Someone regrets talking about their injured hip.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hip' looks like a body part; it means fashionable.
explanation.definitionFit: Ruined and damaged both mean spoilt or wrecked.

clue.text: Possibly one employed by great church

definitions.text: Possibly one employed by great church

indicators.note: employed by means used within, so the one letter is placed inside the church

parts.note: a minster is a large or important church, such as York Minster
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A cleric, perhaps, who works for a cathedral.
explanation.definitionFit: A clergyman serving a church is one possible employee of a large church, hence the hedge.

clue.text: Incredibly remote extraterrestrial object

indicators.note: incredibly signals that the letters are jumbled beyond belief into a new order

explanation.surface: Something from space that is unbelievably distant.
explanation.definitionFit: A shooting star is a piece of space rock burning up as it enters Earth's atmosphere.
